name: tests-75pct-dtls-handshake-message-semantic-validation
instr:
Add semantic validation for ClientHello, ServerHello and EncryptedExtensions. Preserve existing behaviour.

Hello-family Validate(context) methods and ValidateMessage(message, context) return matching, repeatable ValidationReports with the message's Type() and independent issue data. Validation leaves extension payloads and valid-message wire encodings unchanged; reports survive source mutation.

For DTLS 1.2 ClientHello, accept a 32-byte session ID and 255-byte cookie. Report separate InvalidLength issues with distinct Fields for oversized session IDs and cookies, and EmptyOffer for no cipher suites. ServerHello reports one MissingValue per absent cipher or compression selection, with distinct Fields when both are absent. Valid hello selections and empty EncryptedExtensions have no issues. Duplicate supported-groups extensions in ClientHello and duplicate ALPN extensions in ServerHello or EncryptedExtensions produce one DuplicateExtension issue identifying ExtensionType.

For DTLS 1.3, ClientHello return-routability-check without its dependency reports MissingDependency; Cookie in EncryptedExtensions reports ForbiddenExtension; nonzero ServerHello compression reports InvalidSelection; a ServerHello without retry extensions in Retry context reports InvalidRetry.

For a client hook replacing ClientHello.Version with zero, Default emits without observing; Strict observes and returns *HandshakeValidationError before writing; ReportOnly observes and permits writing. Strict Detach
